gates.requirement: Explicit non-anthropocentric coding rules exist for innovation, traditions, cumulative improvement, repertoire breadth, distributed knowledge, externalization and open-endedness; pilot-driven changes must be logged.
Predictor families are frozen before confirmatory modeling; later additions require a logged rationale.

A reproducible 29-species OpenAlex exposure proxy now exists for all-taxonomy, general behaviour, cognition, social transmission, manipulation, and communication searches. Confirmatory work must still audit tested-negative evidence and validate sensitivity to query definitions.

All 29 species-level v2 taxa resolve exactly in OpenTree and a synthetic induced topology was generated. Confirmatory PGLS/rate models still require a dated within-clade tree or an explicitly justified branch-length strategy.

The canonical panel is now 29 exact species; 29/29 have an exact-species evidence route and module_evidence_state_v2 records the A–J observed mask. Behavioral modules remain sparse, so this is an integration pass rather than confirmatory completeness.

Observed 29×10 coverage yields recovery ≈0.660 additive, 0.346 weakest-link and 0.162 threshold in the design diagnostic. Even complete random 29-taxon sampling remains weak for threshold identification. Unblock by expanding A/C/D/E/F coverage and selecting configuration-diverse counterexample taxa, then rerun.

Fifteen first-secure archaeological milestone intervals and fourteen temporal falsification tests are coded with attribution/preservation caveats. Eleven pairwise dated contradictions passed interval-direction audit. Expand source coverage and uncertainty model before confirmatory temporal inference.

Closest-prior-work map completed and novelty narrowed to cross-clade configuration-model competition with falsification of causal necessity/sufficiency, bias controls, and temporal triangulation. Broader citation chaining remains required before manuscript submission.

Neural data are stored by region, counting method, clade and comparability class; global raw brain-mass/total-neuron scoring is prohibited. Seed data cover humans, elephant, multiple birds, honeybee, octopus and a cetacean method calibrator; exact pilot coverage must be expanded before confirmatory modeling.
Paper 008 is frozen to ARIS v0.4.26 tag commit 951654847b015585385b2448c5667dcd04e7b56b; future engine upgrades must not rewrite this run's provenance.
